BiblicalUsage: The hare is named twice, in the lists of unclean animals. It chews the cud but does not divide the hoof, and so the law says it is unclean to you, and you shall not eat of it.
TheologicalSignificance: One small animal in the food laws carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the lesson, that God's people were set apart even at the table, by what they would and would not eat.
